scientific_integrity: The known minimum-weight formula from Ferrari, Leoni, and Lopez Pujato is credited, and the new contribution is only minimizer multiplicities and structure. Exact finite checks are not presented as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Minimum-weight coefficient on the squares of simple cycles with n>=5 only; no full domination-polynomial claim. All-prior-work historical priority not exhaustively certified.
title: Exact minimum Italian-domination multiplicities for squares of cycles
